notes.title: UPDATE : Redemption arc
notes.content:
Hello everyone. Today is a special day. We're proud to announce you the release of the first update of Vandalhalla !

It was a really long month and it was hard to pull off, but thanks to your support and your invaluable feedback the game is now better than ever.

[h1]FIVE NINETY NINE VERY NICE ![/h1]
In the long term we want Vandalhalla to be a F2P, and as we take another step toward this goal, we decided to reduce the price to 5.99 $.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40741797/320a9a112bc2283cb9e81b040a88186bfde806a0.png[/img]

[h1]TUTORIAL REWORK, CURRENTLY TEACHES SOMTHING[/h1]
First, we reworked the tutorial to match the feedback and experiences from the players. Now it explains more properly and elegantly the core mechanics of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40741797/9ae44a8d0e6bbf97ce29d8b3fe7b300cbf2662b4.png[/img]

[h1]RGB SYSTEM REWORKED[/h1]
Speaking of the core mechanics of the game. The colour system got simplified and now is much easier to understand and use. Your gravity gun is still determined by your colour, but your advantage and weakness towards other colour is only determined by your gravity gun colour. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40741797/402724a072f8254b3a0e94a2cde6c6c4e6f99a21.png[/img]

[h1]LOBBY LISTING (NO FUNNY TITLE HERE)[/h1]
Another major issue that was patched is the matchmaking. It was not optimal for our game in more than one way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40741797/194fff3929b85ff119fe5ea454f8f704b51669d8.png[/img]

Now you can consult, access, join and manage lobbies. You can create a room with custom settings, and invite your friends. You can search the perfect room with specific filter such as the name, ping or if the room is public or not.

[h1]ONE STEP FURTHER TO SOME FAMOUS MOVIE TITLE EVERYONE KNOW[/h1]
The game is welcoming the presence of AI. They are great for filling a room if there aren't enough players or if you want to challenge the computer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40741797/5bf22f69e91328e80c9ad2b9148d3a180775fd7c.png[/img]

[h1]YOU ARE GETTING THE FULL GAME THIS TIME FOR HALF THE PRICE[/h1]
Finally some of you have rightfully pointed out the fact that locking abilities is not good. And you're right, locking them is not fun, so everyone will have every ability unlocked from the beginning.

Patch note :
[expand type=details]
[Feature] - Addition of LOBBY listing.
[Feature] - Addition of colours in the weapon carousel.
[Feature] - Addition of AI

[Change] - Tutorial rework.
[Change] - Colour system rework.
[Change] - ALL abilities UNLOCKED.

[BUG] - Gravity Mines are no more stuck after propulsion.
[BUG] - Missiles are no more stuck after being grab.

[Visual fix] - Map buildings have no more missing parts.
[Visual fix] - Neon shader modified to run faster.
[Visual fix] - Menu load correctly after death.
[/expand]
We hope that you will like this update and we wish you a good holiday.

notes.title: We are sorry for this messy game release.
notes.content:
Sorry guys, this release was a mess and we **** up on many levels, resulting in a lot of things on the game that were not as good as we expected.

Some of you took their time and pointed at us exactly what we couldn't see (thanks for all of you that did it) and we intend on fixing most of these points on the next incoming patch.

There will be an update before December.

PATCH NOTE :

-The quest system will be removed and all the abilities will be given. The game is fun with all its abilities unlocked so you can play the way you want.

-The matchmaking will be changed. There is not enough player for a proper matchmaking to works so you will be granted the ability to host and configure easily servers, and be able to see the server list and join the one you want.

-The color system will be simplified. It is quite hard and scary to newcomer, so a little modification is needed.

-There will be A.I. to play with or against you. This way you can play alone against a machine or fill a room. All theses modifications are what we see as the best in short term.

Stay tuned on our social medias for more info about the progress and for giveaway of game keys :D
